promptInjection.limitation: Counts security failures in the injection scenario, including its benign first turn; not a per-attack success rate.

context.limitation: A score below 100 is a review signal, not automatically a confirmed context-loss defect. Per-turn judge analysis and errors are preserved.

toolCalling.limitation: The assistant has no configured tools or recorded tool-call traces. Never counted as PASS.

bonus.apiAndUi: NOT_EVALUATED for semantic hallucination/injection/toxicity/context/tool-call detection. API/UI assertions and execution failures are consolidated separately.
bonus.calibration: Existing LLM judge outputs are aggregated without new provider calls. Detector sensitivity/false-positive rates remain uncalibrated.
